description:
Start a simulation job named by its job type and return at once with its id, without waiting for the result.
Inputs: jobType, one of the 13 job types list_simulation_tools names; params, that job type's parameters, validated here against its contract before anything is sent (each one's unit, range and default is in the matching simulate_* tool's schema); inputFiles or inputPaths for a job type that takes files. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY.
Example: {"jobType":"antenna_sim","params":{"solveMode":"instant","freq":146000000}}
Returns: jobId, jobType, status, queue position, the time budget, a suggested wait and the result page URL. An identical submission inside 60 s returns the same job.
Counts against the monthly run allowance. The typed simulate_* tool for a job type does the same and waits for the result.

inputFiles.description: Inline files for file-input job types. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY.

name.description: File name including its extension, e.g. "channel.s4p"

inputPaths.description: Local file paths for file-input job types. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY.

params.description: Parameters for that job type, validated locally against its contract

name: submit_simulation
title: Submit Simulation
